{{Quote|Masters, I am struggling with this&mdash;Roan Fel still commanded the Empire when it struck at Ossus. Yet we are looking to be his friend?|Hira|<ref name="Legacy 45" />}}
'''Hira''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] who wielded a yellow-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Master Hira!|[[Shado Vao]], upon witnessing Hira's death|<ref name="Legacy 46" />}}
[[File:DeathofHira.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Hira is killed.]]
Following the loss of the [[New Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the [[Massacre at Ossus]], Hira went into hiding and was later present during the peace talks on [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] between the [[New Jedi Order]] and [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] seven years later in [[137 ABY]], alongside [[K'Kruhk]], [[Rasi Tuum]], and [[Shado Vao]]. Hira was unsure as to why they were attempting to form an alliance with the man who nearly wiped out the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], but K'Kruhk pointed out that [[Marasiah Fel]] had revealed that the attack was actually against the Emperor's orders.<ref name="Legacy 45" />

During the following [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Imperial]] ambush codenamed [[Operation: Thunderstroke]], Master Hira fought alongside the other Jedi and the [[Imperial Knight]]s to defend Roan Fel from warriors of the [[One Sith]]. Hira was killed by an [[Unidentified Nautolan Sith (Agamar)|unidentified]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], who electrocuted the Jedi with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].<ref name="Legacy 46" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Powers and abilities==
Hira was a skilled enough [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to ascend to the position of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and survive the near [[Third Jedi Purge|extermination]] of the Jedi Order for seven years<ref name="Legacy 45" /> before finally being killed in battle against a Sith Lord.<ref name="Legacy 46" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hira appeared in issues [[Legacy (2006) 45|forty-five]]<ref name="Legacy 45" /> and [[Legacy (2006) 46|forty-six]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', in the final parts of the [[Star Wars: Legacy: Monster|''Monster'' arc]].<ref name="Legacy 46" />
